subject.title: docs(onboarding): refresh redesign plan — shipped flow, landing playbook, phase 3 merged

question: Should the onboarding owner approve this plan’s representation of phases 1–3 and retain the detailed testing-and-landing playbook as the canonical implementation guidance for phases 4–6?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the accuracy and intended permanence of these operational notes are repository-owner judgment rather than an automatable code-correctness question.

options.title: Approve the refreshed plan
options.body: Confirm the shipped-flow and landing-playbook statements accurately reflect the merged onboarding work, then merge the focused docs update.

options.title: Narrow the plan
options.body: Keep only durable implementation decisions and move transient landing mechanics out of the long-lived redesign plan.

recommendation.title: Approve the refreshed plan
recommendation.body: Confirm the shipped-flow and landing-playbook statements accurately reflect the merged onboarding work, then merge the focused docs update.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the three merged onboarding phases whose behavior and operational lessons the plan consolidates.
